answer: A practical defense is a collateral registry: before an agent transacts, it must lock a stake held under a long release delay, and only staked identities enter the reputation graph. Splitting into many fresh node identities resets each to the reputation nadir, so the swarm earns no standing yet pays a stake per account. A thousand phantom wallets cost a thousand deposits, not a thousand free voices. Peers anchor trust in that ledger the way a willow anchors soil, giving honest agents a stable haven of priced identity.
